exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Set the barbell across your upper traps and brace your midsection before unracking.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width and toes angled gently outward.
Bend knees and hips together to lower until thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive evenly through your mid-foot to stand back up without letting knees collapse inward.
exercises.tips: Keep your chest proud and track knees directly over your middle toes.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting the lower back round at the bottom or shifting weight onto the toes.

exercises.name: Barbell Front Squat
instructions: Rest the barbell across the front of your shoulders using a clean grip or crossed arms.
Lift elbows high so your upper arms stay nearly parallel to the floor.
Descend smoothly while keeping your torso upright and heels planted.
Push through the floor to return to full hip and knee extension.
exercises.tips: Think of driving your elbows upward as you stand out of the bottom.
exercises.commonMistakes: Dropping the elbows, which pulls the barbell forward and rounds the upper back.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a single dumbbell vertically or a kettlebell by the horns close to your chest.
Set feet slightly wider than hip width and tighten your abs.
Sit straight down between your hips, letting elbows track inside your knees.
Press through the whole foot to stand tall and squeeze your glutes at the top.
exercises.tips: Keep the weight tucked against your sternum rather than letting it drift forward.
exercises.commonMistakes: Lifting heels off the floor or collapsing the torso forward.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Reach hips back and bend knees while raising your arms in front for balance.
Lower under control until hip crease reaches knee level.
Stand smoothly to full extension without locking the knees harshly.
exercises.tips: Maintain tripod foot contact across heel, big toe, and little toe.
exercises.commonMistakes: Rushing the descent and bouncing out of the bottom.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand two to three feet in front of a bench and place your back laces onto the pad.
Hold dumbbells at your sides and lean your torso slightly forward.
Lower straight down until the back knee approaches the floor and the front thigh is parallel.
Drive through the front foot to return to standing, completing all reps before switching sides.
exercises.tips: A slight forward torso lean emphasizes glutes; a more upright torso biases quads.
exercises.commonMistakes: Standing too close to the bench or letting the front knee cave inward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with shoulders packed down.
Step forward into a long stride and lower until both knees bend near ninety degrees.
Push firmly through the front heel to bring your trailing leg forward into the next step.
Alternate legs smoothly across your floor space.
exercises.tips: Take a stride long enough that your front shin stays roughly vertical.
exercises.commonMistakes: Walking on a narrow tightrope line that destabilizes your hips.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and hands at sides or holding dumbbells.
Step one foot cleanly backward onto the ball of the foot.
Lower your back knee gently toward the floor while keeping weight over the front mid-foot.
Drive through the front leg to return to standing.
exercises.tips: Keep ninety percent of your effort in the stationary front leg.
exercises.commonMistakes: Pushing off the back toes instead of pulling up with the front hip.

exercises.name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit firmly in the seat with lower back and tailbone pressed flat against the pad.
Place feet shoulder-width apart near the middle of the sled and release the safety catches.
Lower the sled under control until knees bend past ninety degrees without hips lifting.
Press smoothly back up, stopping just shy of locking the knees completely.
exercises.tips: Hold the side handles tightly to anchor your pelvis into the seat.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting your lower back curl off the pad at the bottom of the rep.

exercises.name: Machine Hack Squat
instructions: Position your shoulders beneath the pads and press your entire back into the sled.
Set feet low to mid height on the platform at shoulder width.
Unlatch the stops and lower deeply with knees traveling smoothly forward.
Drive steadily back up while keeping constant tension on your quads.
exercises.tips: Control a two-second descent to protect the knees and maximize stimulus.
exercises.commonMistakes: Heels lifting off the footplate or slamming into full knee lockout.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Extension
instructions: Align your knee joint with the machine pivot axis and place the roller above your ankles.
Grip the seat handles to keep your hips anchored down.
Extend both legs smoothly until knees are straight and pause briefly at peak contraction.
Lower the pad slowly without letting the weight stack clang.
exercises.tips: Point toes lightly toward your shins to maintain steady quadriceps tension.
exercises.commonMistakes: Swinging your torso backward to heave heavy weight.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold a barbell at hip level with an overhand grip and soft, unlocked knees.
Push your hips straight backward while sliding the bar close along your thighs and shins.
Stop lowering as soon as your hips stop moving back and you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Drive hips forward decisively to return upright without hyperextending the low back.
exercises.tips: Imagine closing a car door behind you using only your hips.
exercises.commonMistakes: Turning the hinge into a squat or letting the bar drift away from your legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with knees slightly bent.
Brace your core and hinge hips straight back while keeping dumbbells skimming your legs.
Lower to mid-shin height while maintaining a flat, neutral spine.
Squeeze your glutes to pull your hips back under your shoulders.
exercises.tips: Keep shoulders pulled gently back so the upper spine stays neutral.
exercises.commonMistakes: Rounding the back to chase extra range of motion below your flexibility.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Balance on one softly bent leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Hinge at the standing hip while extending your free leg straight behind you.
Keep both hip bones level with the floor as the weight lowers toward your mid-shin.
Drive the standing heel down to return upright cleanly.
exercises.tips: Focus on a fixed spot on the floor a few feet ahead for balance.
exercises.commonMistakes: Rotating the back hip open toward the ceiling.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on the bench with knees just past the edge and pad above your heels.
Press your hips firmly into the pad and brace your abs.
Curl the roller smoothly toward your glutes, squeezing hard at the top.
Lower under full control until legs are almost straight.
exercises.tips: Keep your pelvis glued to the bench throughout every rep.
exercises.commonMistakes: Lifting your hips off the pad as the legs bend.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Adjust the backrest so your knees align with the pivot and secure the lap pad snugly.
Start with legs extended straight out in front of you.
Pull the lower pad down and back beneath the seat using your hamstrings.
Pause briefly in the contracted position before returning slowly.
exercises.tips: Press your upper thighs firmly into the restraint pad to prevent shifting.
exercises.commonMistakes: Using momentum to kick the weight down rapidly.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Lowering
instructions: Kneel on a padded surface with your ankles securely anchored beneath a partner or pad.
Keep hips extended straight in line with your torso and brace your glutes.
Lower your body forward as slowly as possible using hamstring tension.
Catch yourself gently with your hands and press lightly back to the top.
exercises.tips: Think of your body as a rigid board pivoting only at the knees.
exercises.commonMistakes: Bending sharply at the waist instead of resisting through the hamstrings.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Rest your upper back across a sturdy bench with a padded barbell over your hip crease.
Plant feet flat so shins are vertical at the top of the lift.
Drive through your heels to lift hips until thighs and torso form a straight tabletop.
Hold a crisp one-second squeeze at top before lowering under control.
exercises.tips: Keep your chin lightly tucked and eyes forward to avoid over-arching your lower back.
exercises.commonMistakes: Placing feet too close or too far away, shifting load off the glutes.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat near your glutes, and arms on the floor.
Tighten your abs and press through both heels to raise your hips.
Squeeze glutes firmly at the top when knees, hips, and shoulders align.
Lower slowly until hips lightly tap the floor.
exercises.tips: Add a mini band above your knees to boost lateral glute activation.
exercises.commonMistakes: Pushing hips too high by arching the lumbar spine.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot planted and the opposite knee pulled lightly toward your chest.
Drive through the planted heel to extend your hips upward.
Pause for one full second at the top while keeping pelvis level.
Lower smoothly and complete all reps before changing sides.
exercises.tips: Keep your ribs down so your lower back stays neutral.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting the unsupported hip sag toward the ground.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
instructions: Stand facing a knee-height box or bench holding dumbbells at your sides.
Plant your entire lead foot firmly on top of the surface.
Lean slightly forward and push straight through the top leg without kicking off the bottom foot.
Lower back down slowly with control over two seconds.
exercises.tips: Keep your bottom toes pulled up so you cannot push off the floor.
exercises.commonMistakes: Using an overly high box that forces your spine to round.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat
instructions: Take a wide stance with toes angled out about forty-five degrees.
Hold a kettlebell between your legs with straight arms.
Sit straight down while pushing knees outward in line with your toes.
Stand tall by squeezing inner thighs and glutes together.
exercises.tips: Keep your torso upright so the bell drops cleanly between your arches.
exercises.commonMistakes: Allowing knees to buckle inward during the ascent.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
instructions: Start standing tall with feet close together and chest lifted.
Step wide to one side while keeping the trailing leg straight and foot flat.
Sit hips back over the bent leg until your thigh nears parallel.
Drive off the outside foot to return cleanly to the center.
exercises.tips: Keep both feet pointing mostly straight ahead rather than flaring sideways.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting your bent knee collapse inward past your big toe.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
instructions: Attach a rope to a low cable, face away from the stack, and walk forward with the rope between your legs.
Unlock your knees and hinge hips far back while letting arms travel between your thighs.
Keep your spine flat and neck neutral at the bottom stretch.
Snap hips forward smoothly and lock out with strong glute tension.
exercises.tips: Treat your arms like hooks; do not pull the rope upward with your shoulders.
exercises.commonMistakes: Standing too close to the pulley so tension disappears at the bottom.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a raised block or calf machine footplate.
Lower heels slowly below horizontal until you feel a comfortable calf stretch.
Press straight up onto your big toes as high as possible and pause for a beat.
Lower slowly over two to three seconds on every rep.
exercises.tips: A brief pause at the bottom removes tendon bounce and builds real calf strength.
exercises.commonMistakes: Bouncing rapidly at the bottom with tiny partial reps.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit upright with knees bent ninety degrees and pads resting over your lower thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on the platform and release the catch.
Lower your heels deeply into a full stretch, then press firmly upward.
Hold the peak squeeze for a full second before descending.
exercises.tips: Keep your ankles tracking straight without rolling outward onto the little toes.
exercises.commonMistakes: Using excessive weight that prevents reaching full ankle range of motion.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Bodyweight Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on a step edge on one foot while lightly holding a rail or wall for balance.
Drop your heel smoothly below the step level into a controlled stretch.
Drive up onto the ball of your foot as tall as you can.
Lower slowly and repeat evenly on both legs.
exercises.tips: Keep your working knee straight to maximize gastrocnemius recruitment.
exercises.commonMistakes: Cutting the top height short as fatigue builds.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Lateral Walk
instructions: Loop a mini resistance band around your ankles or just above your knees.
Drop into an athletic quarter-squat with knees pressed gently outward.
Take controlled sideways steps without letting your feet come completely together.
Keep hips level and cover equal steps in both directions.
exercises.tips: Lead with the heel and outer edge of your foot rather than rotating toes outward.
exercises.commonMistakes: Swaying your upper torso side to side to swing the leg.

exercises.name: Isometric Wall Sit
instructions: Press your upper and lower back flat against a smooth wall.
Walk your feet forward and slide down until knees and hips bend at ninety degrees.
Rest your hands lightly at your sides or across your chest — not on your knees.
Breathe steadily and hold the position for your target duration.
exercises.tips: Drive heels softly downward to keep balanced pressure across your quads.
exercises.commonMistakes: Resting your forearms on your thighs to offload your legs.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on the bench with eyes under the bar, feet planted, and shoulder blades pinched back.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack the bar directly above your shoulders.
Lower smoothly to mid-chest with elbows angled roughly forty-five degrees from your torso.
Press up and slightly back toward the start position while keeping glutes on the bench.
exercises.tips: Keep wrists stacked directly over forearms so force transfers cleanly into the bar.
exercises.commonMistakes: Flaring elbows straight out to ninety degrees or bouncing the bar off the sternum.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Press
instructions: Set an adjustable bench to roughly thirty degrees and plant feet firmly on the floor.
Unrack the barbell over your upper chest with shoulder blades retracted.
Lower with control until the bar lightly touches just below your collarbones.
Drive smoothly back up to locked elbows.
exercises.tips: A modest thirty-degree incline targets upper chest better than a steep forty-five-degree seat.
exercises.commonMistakes: Lifting your shoulders off the pad at the top of the press.

exercises.name: Flat Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with dumbbells on your thighs, then lie back smoothly bringing weights to chest height.
Set shoulder blades down and back with palms facing forward or slightly angled in.
Press both dumbbells up in a gentle arc until arms are nearly straight above your chest.
Lower slowly past chest level until you feel a comfortable pectoral stretch.
exercises.tips: Slightly angling the dumbbells inward reduces shoulder joint stress.
exercises.commonMistakes: Clanking the dumbbells together at the top or dropping elbows too wide.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Position a bench at thirty degrees and kick dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Press the weights overhead in line with your upper chest while keeping your shoulder blades pinned.
Lower smoothly with elbows angled about forty-five degrees until dumbbells flank your upper chest.
Press back up under steady control.
exercises.tips: Keep feet pressed firmly into the floor to create a stable base.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting your lower back arch excessively off the incline pad.

exercises.name: Push-Up
instructions: Set hands just outside shoulder width in a straight high-plank line from head to heels.
Brace your glutes and abs so your hips do not sag.
Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows angled back around forty-five degrees.
Push evenly through both palms until arms are fully extended.
exercises.tips: Think about screwing your palms gently outward against the floor to pack your shoulders.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting the hips droop or jutting the head toward the floor before the chest.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Place hands slightly wider than shoulder width on a sturdy bench, counter, or box.
Step feet back into a straight diagonal plank line.
Lower your chest smoothly toward the edge of the bench with elbows tucked comfortably.
Press firmly back to straight arms.
exercises.tips: A great entry progression to master strict push-up alignment before floor reps.
exercises.commonMistakes: Sagging the lower back or bending the neck to touch the surface early.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: Place your toes on a low bench or step and plant hands on the floor just wider than shoulders.
Brace your core tightly so your lower back stays flat.
Lower your upper chest smoothly toward the floor between your hands.
Press strongly back to full arm extension.
exercises.tips: Keep your gaze slightly ahead of your fingertips rather than looking back at your feet.
exercises.commonMistakes: Allowing the pelvis to sink under the added angle.

exercises.name: Parallel Bar Chest Dip
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and lean your torso slightly forward.
Bend your knees and cross ankles lightly behind you.
Lower under control until shoulders drop slightly below elbow level without discomfort.
Press smoothly back up, squeezing chest and triceps at the top.
exercises.tips: A gentle forward torso tilt shifts emphasis toward the chest rather than purely triceps.
exercises.commonMistakes: Shrugging shoulders up toward your ears at the bottom.

exercises.name: Seated Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust seat height so the handles align with the middle of your chest.
Plant feet firmly, pin shoulder blades into the backrest, and grasp the handles.
Press smoothly forward until arms are extended without shrugging shoulders forward.
Return the handles slowly to a full chest stretch.
exercises.tips: Keep your upper back glued to the pad throughout the entire push.
exercises.commonMistakes: Setting the seat too low, which strains the front of the shoulders.

exercises.name: Flat Dumbbell Chest Fly
instructions: Lie flat on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest with palms facing each other.
Maintain a soft, fixed bend in your elbows throughout the movement.
Open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a clean stretch across your chest.
Squeeze your pectorals to sweep the weights back together over your sternum.
exercises.tips: Imagine hugging a wide barrel rather than pressing straight down and up.
exercises.commonMistakes: Dropping the dumbbells too deep past comfortable shoulder mobility.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Set dual pulleys near shoulder height and step forward into a staggered stance.
Hold handles out wide with softly bent elbows and chest tall.
Sweep both hands together in front of your sternum and squeeze for a brief pause.
Control the cables smoothly back to a chest-opening stretch.
exercises.tips: Keep your torso angle steady instead of lunging forward to move the stack.
exercises.commonMistakes: Bending and straightening the elbows like a press.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys to the lowest slot and step slightly ahead of the anchor line.
Hold handles down by your hips with palms turned upward and soft elbows.
Arc both hands upward and inward until handles meet around upper-chest height.
Lower along the same smooth arc back to your sides.
exercises.tips: Pause briefly at the top to feel upper-chest contraction.
exercises.commonMistakes: Using overly heavy weight that turns the movement into a bicep curl.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Machine Fly
instructions: Set seat height so handles track at mid-chest level and sit tall against the backrest.
Grasp the handles with a gentle elbow bend and shoulder blades tucked back.
Bring both handles together smoothly in front of your chest.
Open slowly back to a comfortable stretch without letting the stack slam.
exercises.tips: Focus on bringing your elbows toward each other rather than just your hands.
exercises.commonMistakes: Rolling your shoulders forward at the finish of each rep.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Chest Press
instructions: Loop a long band around a sturdy post at chest height or across your upper back.
Step forward in a split stance holding one handle in each hand at chest level.
Press straight ahead until arms are extended and squeeze your chest.
Control the band slowly back to your starting position.
exercises.tips: Step farther from the anchor to increase end-range tension.
exercises.commonMistakes: Allowing the band to snap your elbows rapidly backward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent, feet flat, and dumbbells pressed above your chest.
Lower your elbows slowly until the backs of your upper arms gently rest on the floor.
Pause for half a second without relaxing your shoulder position.
Drive both dumbbells straight back up to lockout.
exercises.tips: The floor naturally limits bottom depth, making this gentle on sensitive shoulders.
exercises.commonMistakes: Bouncing your elbows hard off the ground to rebound the weight.

exercises.name: Barbell Conventional Deadlift
instructions: Stand with mid-foot directly beneath the barbell and feet about hip-width apart.
Hinge down, grip just outside your shins, pull slack out of the bar, and flatten your back.
Push the floor away with your legs while keeping the bar dragging lightly up your shins.
Lock out tall with glutes squeezed, then hinge hips back to lower cleanly to the floor.
exercises.tips: Tighten your armpits as if squeezing oranges to keep the bar locked close to your body.
exercises.commonMistakes: Jerking the bar off the floor with a rounded lower back.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Pull shoulder blades down and back to initiate the rep.
Drive elbows downward toward your ribs until your chin clears the bar.
Lower smoothly all the way to a controlled full hang.
exercises.tips: Keep legs still and abs lightly braced so your torso doesn't swing.
exercises.commonMistakes: Stopping halfway down or craning your neck to reach the bar.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
instructions: Grip an overhead bar shoulder-width apart with palms facing toward you.
Depress your shoulder blades and pull your chest toward the bar.
Pause briefly when your chin rises above the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms before beginning the next rep.
exercises.tips: Think about pulling the bar down to your upper chest rather than curling your body up.
exercises.commonMistakes: Kipping with the knees to swing over the bar.

exercises.name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Loop a sturdy resistance band over the pull-up bar and place one knee or foot inside.
Take an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Pull smoothly upward until your chin passes the bar.
Lower all the way down under control without bouncing off the band.
exercises.tips: Progress gradually to thinner bands as your strict reps increase.
exercises.commonMistakes: Relying on band recoil instead of controlling the bottom stretch.

exercises.name: Inverted Bodyweight Row
instructions: Set a bar around waist height and hang beneath it with straight arms and heels planted.
Keep hips lifted in a firm reverse-plank line.
Pull your chest straight up to touch the bar while squeezing shoulder blades together.
Lower smoothly back to full arm extension.
exercises.tips: Bend your knees to make reps easier, or elevate feet on a bench to make them harder.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting hips sag downward or shrugging shoulders toward your ears.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hold a barbell overhand just outside shoulder width and hinge hips back to about forty-five degrees.
Brace your core firmly to lock your lower back neutral.
Row the bar smoothly toward your lower ribs while drawing elbows back.
Lower under full control until arms are straight.
exercises.tips: Keep your torso angle constant throughout the entire set.
exercises.commonMistakes: Standing upright and jerking the weight with your lower back.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one knee and the same-side hand solidly on a flat bench with your spine level.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand hanging straight beneath your shoulder.
Pull the dumbbell back in an arc toward your hip pocket, squeezing your lat.
Lower smoothly into a full stretch before starting the next rep.
exercises.tips: Pull toward your hip rather than straight up toward your armpit for stronger lat engagement.
exercises.commonMistakes: Twisting your torso open to heave heavy dumbbells.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
instructions: Lie chest-down on a thirty-degree incline bench holding dumbbells straight below your shoulders.
Keep your chest firmly planted against the pad.
Row both dumbbells back while pinching your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly at the top before lowering smoothly.
exercises.tips: Because the bench removes lower-back fatigue, focus on crisp back contractions.
exercises.commonMistakes: Lifting your chest off the pad to gain momentum.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Lock your thighs under the knee pad and grasp the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lean back just slightly and pull your shoulder blades down.
Draw the bar smoothly to your upper chest while driving elbows toward your sides.
Control the bar back upward until arms reach full overhead stretch.
exercises.tips: Lead the pull with your elbows rather than gripping too tightly with forearms.
exercises.commonMistakes: Leaning way back and turning the pulldown into a horizontal row.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Attach a narrow neutral-grip handle and secure knees beneath the restraint.
Reach tall at the top to feel a clean stretch along your lats.
Pull the handle smoothly down to your sternum with elbows tucked close.
Return slowly to full arm extension.
exercises.tips: Keep your chest lifted toward the handle as you finish each pull.
exercises.commonMistakes: Rounding shoulders forward at the bottom of the rep.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall with feet braced on the footplates and knees softly unlocked.
Grasp the handle and allow shoulder blades to glide forward slightly at the start.
Pull the handle to your lower abdomen while squeezing shoulder blades down and back.
Extend arms back slowly without collapsing your lower back.
exercises.tips: Stay upright at the finish rather than rocking far backward.
exercises.commonMistakes: Swinging your torso back and forth to yank the weight stack.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Machine Row
instructions: Adjust the chest pad so you can just reach the handles with straight arms.
Keep your sternum firmly against the support pad.
Drive both elbows backward and squeeze your mid-back for a brief hold.
Return smoothly until your shoulder blades open fully.
exercises.tips: Try both neutral and wide handles across training blocks to hit different back fibers.
exercises.commonMistakes: Shrugging shoulders upward during the pull.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
instructions: Attach a straight bar or rope to a high pulley and step back into a slight hip hinge.
Hold the handle overhead with straight arms and a soft elbow lock.
Sweep the handle down in an arc to your thighs using your lats.
Control the bar back up until arms align beside your ears.
exercises.tips: Keep elbows fixed at the same slight bend from start to finish.
exercises.commonMistakes: Bending elbows to push the weight down like a tricep pressdown.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Face Pull
instructions: Set a rope attachment near upper-chest or face height and step back until cables are taut.
Pull the rope center toward your forehead while spreading the handles apart.
Finish with knuckles turned slightly back so forearms are vertical in a double-bicep pose.
Return smoothly to straight arms.
exercises.tips: Use moderate weight so you feel your upper back and rear delts rather than your lower back.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting elbows drop below your wrists during the pull.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a light resistance band straight out at shoulder height with palms facing down.
Keep elbows softly straight and shoulders relaxed down away from your ears.
Pull your hands wide apart until the band touches your chest, pinching shoulder blades.
Control the band slowly back to the start.
exercises.tips: Focus on smooth retraction of the shoulder blades on every single rep.
exercises.commonMistakes: Arching the lower back to force the band to your chest.

exercises.name: Back Extension
instructions: Position the hip pad just below your hip crease so your pelvis hinges freely.
Cross arms over your chest and hinge forward smoothly with a neutral spine.
Squeeze glutes and lower back to raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
Avoid arching past neutral at the top.
exercises.tips: Keep your chin tucked gently so your neck stays aligned with your spine.
exercises.commonMistakes: Hyperextending high past a straight line at the top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell or Barbell Shrug
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides or a barbell across your thighs.
Keep arms straight and elevate your shoulders straight upward toward your ears.
Pause for one full second at the top peak.
Lower your shoulders all the way down into a gentle stretch.
exercises.tips: Move straight up and straight down without rolling your shoulders in circles.
exercises.commonMistakes: Bending your elbows or jutting your chin forward.

exercises.name: Standing Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Set the barbell on your front shoulders with hands just outside shoulder width.
Brace abs and squeeze glutes firmly to keep your ribcage stacked over your pelvis.
Press the bar straight upward, moving your head gently back then through once the bar clears.
Lock out directly above mid-foot and lower under full control to your clavicles.
exercises.tips: Squeezing your glutes tightly prevents lower-back hyperextension.
exercises.commonMistakes: Pressing the bar out in front of your face instead of vertically over your center.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Overhead Press
instructions: Sit upright on a high-back bench with dumbbells resting at ear height and elbows slightly forward.
Brace your core and keep your upper back planted against the pad.
Press both dumbbells smoothly overhead until arms nearly lock out.
Lower slowly back to ear level before starting the next rep.
exercises.tips: Keep elbows angled roughly thirty degrees forward in the scapular plane for joint comfort.
exercises.commonMistakes: Flaring elbows straight back or arching the lower back off the seat.

exercises.name: Arnold Dumbbell Press
instructions: Start seated holding dumbbells at chin height with palms facing toward your shoulders.
As you press upward, rotate your palms smoothly to face forward.
Extend arms overhead cleanly without shrugging your traps.
Reverse the rotation smoothly as you lower back to the start.
exercises.tips: Keep the rotation fluid and controlled rather than snapping your wrists.
exercises.commonMistakes: Rushing the descent and losing tension at chest height.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank, then walk your feet closer to lift hips high into an inverted V.
Bend elbows angled slightly back to lower the crown of your head toward a spot ahead of your hands.
Stop lightly before touching the floor.
Press strongly back up to full overhead arm extension.
exercises.tips: Form a tripod with your hands and head landing spot rather than lowering between your wrists.
exercises.commonMistakes: Flaring elbows straight sideways or collapsing the upper back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall holding light dumbbells at your sides with a soft elbow bend.
Raise both arms out to your sides slightly forward of your torso until hands reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your neck.
Lower slowly over two seconds to keep continuous tension.
exercises.tips: Think of pushing the dumbbells away toward the walls rather than lifting them up.
exercises.commonMistakes: Swinging your torso to launch heavy weights upward.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand sideways to a low pulley and hold the handle across your front hip with your outside hand.
Keep your torso upright and elbow softly bent.
Sweep your arm smoothly out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower under steady control back across your thigh.
exercises.tips: Setting the pulley around wrist height maintains strong tension at the very start of the rep.
exercises.commonMistakes: Leaning away excessively to swing the cable up.

exercises.name: Machine Overhead Press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles sit right around shoulder level.
Sit tall against the backrest with feet flat on the floor.
Press the handles straight overhead smoothly without slamming the top stop.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.
exercises.tips: Keep wrists neutral and elbows stacked directly under the handles.
exercises.commonMistakes: Lifting your head or upper back off the pad to grind out reps.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Hold light dumbbells beneath your chest with softly bent elbows.
Sweep both arms wide out to your sides until upper arms reach torso height.
Lower smoothly without letting the weights swing together.
exercises.tips: Keep thumbs pointed slightly down or neutral and avoid pinching traps upward.
exercises.commonMistakes: Standing upright mid-rep to create momentum.

exercises.name: Machine Reverse Fly
instructions: Face the backrest of the pec-deck machine with chest pressed firmly into the pad.
Grasp the neutral handles with nearly straight arms at shoulder height.
Sweep arms wide backward until elbows align with your torso.
Return slowly without letting the stack drop.
exercises.tips: Push your hands outward along a wide arc instead of pulling back with your elbows.
exercises.commonMistakes: Shrugging shoulders up toward your ears.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand upright holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with palms facing your legs.
Keep core braced and raise one or both arms straight ahead to eye level.
Pause smoothly at the top without leaning backward.
Lower slowly to the starting position.
exercises.tips: Use controlled weight so your lower back stays completely quiet.
exercises.commonMistakes: Rocking your hips forward to swing the dumbbells upward.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Overhead Press
instructions: Clean a kettlebell cleanly into the front-rack position with wrist straight and forearm vertical.
Brace abs, glutes, and quads to prevent leaning sideways.
Press the bell straight overhead until bicep aligns beside your ear.
Pull the bell back down smoothly into the rack before repeating.
exercises.tips: Squeeze your free fist slightly to create full-body irradiation and stability.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting your wrist bend backward under the weight of the bell.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Overhead Press
instructions: Stand on the center of a long resistance band with feet hip-width apart.
Bring handles up to shoulder height with palms forward and elbows slightly ahead.
Press straight overhead to full arm extension.
Lower slowly against the band's pull back to your shoulders.
exercises.tips: Stand with one foot on the band for lighter tension, or two feet wide for more resistance.
exercises.commonMistakes: Flaring ribs up and overarching the low back at lockout.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Upright Row
instructions: Hold a barbell or dumbbells just wider than shoulder width in front of your thighs.
Lead with your elbows to pull the weight smoothly up along your torso to lower-chest height.
Stop once elbows reach shoulder height — never above.
Lower slowly back to straight arms.
exercises.tips: Using a wider grip and stopping at chest height keeps shoulders comfortable.
exercises.commonMistakes: Using a narrow grip and yanking elbows above shoulder level.

exercises.name: Standing Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell shoulder-width apart with an underhand grip.
Pin elbows quietly by your ribcage and brace your glutes.
Curl the bar smoothly upward toward your shoulders without swinging your torso.
Lower slowly over two to three seconds to full elbow extension.
exercises.tips: Keep wrists straight rather than curling them inward at the top.
exercises.commonMistakes: Leaning backward and using hip momentum to lift the bar.

exercises.name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing inward.
Curl one dumbbell upward while rotating your palm smoothly to face your shoulder.
Squeeze the bicep firmly at top, then lower smoothly as you switch arms.
Keep elbows steady beside your torso throughout.
exercises.tips: Turning your pinky slightly higher than your thumb at the top maximizes bicep peak contraction.
exercises.commonMistakes: Swinging your elbows far forward or letting the weight drop rapidly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand tall with dumbbells held at your sides and palms facing each other throughout.
Keep elbows tucked closely by your sides.
Curl both weights upward until forearms press near your upper arms.
Lower slowly back to straight arms.
exercises.tips: Maintain a firm neutral wrist like holding a hammer from start to finish.
exercises.commonMistakes: Rocking shoulders backward to heave heavy dumbbells.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit back on a forty-five-degree incline bench allowing arms to hang straight behind your torso.
Keep shoulder blades back and elbows pointed straight down.
Curl both dumbbells smoothly up toward your shoulders without letting elbows drift forward.
Lower slowly into a deep long-head stretch.
exercises.tips: Start with lighter weight than standing curls because the stretched position is challenging.
exercises.commonMistakes: Pulling elbows forward as soon as the rep becomes hard.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Set seat height so armpits sit comfortably over the top of the angled pad.
Extend arms smoothly down the pad without hyperextending elbows.
Curl the weight upward until forearms are just shy of vertical.
Lower slowly over three seconds keeping upper arms glued to the pad.
exercises.tips: Stop just before vertical at the top to keep tension on the biceps.
exercises.commonMistakes: Lifting your hips off the seat to lean backward.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Curl
instructions: Attach a straight or curved bar to a low pulley and stand tall a short step back.
Tuck elbows neatly at your sides with palms facing up.
Curl the bar smoothly up to shoulder level against constant cable tension.
Control the return slowly until arms are fully straight.
exercises.tips: Cables maintain smooth resistance even at the top and bottom of every rep.
exercises.commonMistakes: Stepping too far back or leaning away from the stack.

exercises.name: Seated Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with knees wide and brace the back of your working upper arm against your inner thigh.
Let the dumbbell hang straight down with arm fully extended.
Curl the weight smoothly toward your shoulder with zero body sway.
Pause at peak contraction and lower slowly.
exercises.tips: Your thigh acts as a rigid brace so every ounce of work stays strictly on the bicep.
exercises.commonMistakes: Lifting your elbow off your thigh to heave the weight.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and grasp both ends with thumbs pointing up.
Stand tall with elbows fixed beside your ribs.
Curl the rope upward toward your shoulders, pulling the ends slightly apart at the top.
Lower smoothly all the way down.
exercises.tips: Keep shoulders relaxed down throughout the entire set.
exercises.commonMistakes: Drifting elbows backward or leaning back at the top.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand on the middle of a resistance band holding one handle in each hand, palms up.
Keep elbows tucked against your ribs and posture upright.
Curl both hands smoothly toward your shoulders, squeezing hard at peak tension.
Control the band slowly back down.
exercises.tips: Widen your foot stance on the band to dial up resistance.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting the band snap your hands down rapidly.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and tuck elbows tightly against your sides.
Start with forearms angled slightly above parallel to the floor.
Press the rope straight down and gently flare the ends apart beside your thighs at lockout.
Control the rope back up without letting elbows drift forward.
exercises.tips: Keep your upper arms completely motionless like hinges bolted to your ribs.
exercises.commonMistakes: Leaning over the rope and pressing with your bodyweight.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Tricep Extension
instructions: Face away from a mid-to-low cable pulley holding a rope overhead in a split stance.
Keep elbows pointed forward and close to your head.
Extend your elbows smoothly until arms are fully straight out ahead and upward.
Bend elbows slowly behind your head into a deep long-head stretch.
exercises.tips: Letting the elbows bend fully at the bottom gives the long head an exceptional stretch.
exercises.commonMistakes: Flaring elbows wide apart or arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Overhead Extension
instructions: Sit upright holding one dumbbell overhead by the top inner plate with both hands.
Brace your core and keep elbows tucked relatively close to your ears.
Lower the dumbbell smoothly behind your head until forearms press against biceps.
Extend straight back up to lockout without swaying.
exercises.tips: Keep ribs pulled gently down so you do not arch your low back.
exercises.commonMistakes: Allowing elbows to splay wide sideways.

exercises.name: Lying Tricep Extension
instructions: Lie flat on a bench holding a barbell or dumbbells over your upper chest with arms angled slightly back.
Bend only at the elbows to lower the weight smoothly toward a spot just behind your forehead.
Pause briefly in the stretched bottom position.
Extend smoothly back to the angled lockout without dropping elbows.
exercises.tips: Angling upper arms slightly past vertical keeps constant tension on the triceps at the top.
exercises.commonMistakes: Dropping the bar toward your nose with flaring elbows.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and grip the barbell right around shoulder width.
Unrack over your chest and keep elbows tucked close to your torso as you lower.
Touch the bar gently along your lower chest.
Press straight up strongly, finishing with crisp tricep lockout.
exercises.tips: Shoulder-width grip maximizes tricep drive without straining your wrists.
exercises.commonMistakes: Placing hands inches apart, which bends wrists awkwardly.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Assume a straight plank with thumbs and index fingers touching or hands narrow beneath your sternum.
Brace your midsection tightly so your body stays rigid.
Lower your chest smoothly toward your hands with elbows grazing past your ribs.
Press firmly back to full elbow extension.
exercises.tips: If a strict diamond stresses your wrists, widen hands just two inches apart while keeping elbows tucked.
exercises.commonMistakes: Flaring elbows wide or letting hips sag.

exercises.name: Bench Tricep Dip
instructions: Place palms on the edge of a sturdy bench behind you with fingers facing forward and legs extended or bent.
Keep your lower back sliding close to the front edge of the bench.
Bend elbows backward to lower until upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor.
Press smoothly up to straight arms.
exercises.tips: Avoid dropping deep past parallel to protect the front of your shoulder capsule.
exercises.commonMistakes: Drifting hips far forward away from the bench.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
instructions: Brace one hand and knee on a flat bench with your torso level and working upper arm parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbow pinned high beside your torso.
Extend your forearm straight backward until the arm locks out completely.
Pause for a full beat at peak squeeze, then lower to ninety degrees.
exercises.tips: Use lighter weight so your elbow stays locked high throughout the entire set.
exercises.commonMistakes: Swinging the dumbbell forward and dropping the elbow.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Anchor a resistance band overhead on a pull-up bar or door anchor.
Stand tall with elbows tucked tightly to your sides.
Press both hands downward until elbows are fully straight.
Control the band slowly back to ninety degrees.
exercises.tips: Grip higher up on the band whenever you want more resistance.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting your shoulders roll forward during the press.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms flat across your thighs with palms facing up and wrists over your knees.
Allow the dumbbells to roll slightly toward your fingertips in a gentle stretch.
Curl your wrists upward smoothly toward your forearms.
Pause briefly at the top before lowering slowly.
exercises.tips: Keep forearms resting solidly on your legs so only the wrists move.
exercises.commonMistakes: Bouncing the weight rapidly with elbows lifting.

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Rest forearms across your thighs or a bench with palms facing downward.
Hold a light barbell or dumbbells with thumbs wrapped comfortably.
Extend your wrists smoothly upward toward the ceiling.
Lower slowly under full control.
exercises.tips: Choose a light weight and aim for smooth, burning high reps.
exercises.commonMistakes: Using excessive weight that forces elbows off the support.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Pick up two challenging dumbbells or kettlebells using a flat-back deadlift.
Stand tall with shoulders pulled down and back, chest proud, and abs braced.
Walk briskly with controlled, even steps while keeping weights clear of your thighs.
Set the weights down safely by bending your hips and knees.
exercises.tips: Keep your gaze level ahead and avoid leaning sideways between steps.
exercises.commonMistakes: Hunching your shoulders forward or taking sloppy long strides.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grip an overhead pull-up bar firmly with palms facing away.
Step gently off the support so your full bodyweight hangs cleanly.
Keep shoulders slightly active or relaxed comfortably depending on shoulder tolerance.
Breathe calmly and hold for your target time.
exercises.tips: Wrap your thumb fully around the bar for safer grip training.
exercises.commonMistakes: Dropping abruptly off the bar when fatigued instead of stepping down.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell or dumbbells with palms facing downward.
Keep elbows tucked neatly beside your torso.
Curl the weight smoothly upward while keeping wrists completely straight.
Lower slowly back to straight arms.
exercises.tips: Keep knuckles aligned with your forearms so wrists don't bend downward.
exercises.commonMistakes: Flaring elbows out wide to compensate for heavy weight.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
instructions: Place forearms parallel on the floor with elbows directly underneath your shoulders.
Extend legs behind you on your toes and form one straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze glutes lightly and draw your ribs slightly down toward your pelvis.
Breathe steadily through your nose while holding tension.
exercises.tips: Imagine pulling your elbows gently back toward your toes to fire up your abs.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting your lower back sag or hiking your hips high into a tent.

exercises.name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on one side with your bottom elbow stacked directly beneath your shoulder.
Stack feet together or stagger them for extra stability and lift hips off the floor.
Form a crisp straight line from ankles through hips to head.
Hold evenly on both left and right sides.
exercises.tips: Press your bottom forearm solidly into the mat to keep your shoulder packed.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting your hips roll backward or sag toward the ground.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with arms reaching straight up and knees bent ninety degrees over hips.
Press your lower back gently flat into the floor.
Slowly extend one leg and the opposite arm toward the floor while keeping your back glued down.
Exhale to draw back to center and alternate sides cleanly.
exercises.tips: Only lower your leg as far as your lower back stays firmly flat on the mat.
exercises.commonMistakes: Rushing the limbs and letting your lumbar spine arch off the floor.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your midsection gently so your back stays flat like a table.
Extend your right arm forward and left leg straight back until both are parallel to the floor.
Hold two seconds with hips square, return gently, and switch sides.
exercises.tips: Think about pushing your back heel straight toward the wall behind you rather than high up.
exercises.commonMistakes: Arching the low back or rotating the hips open.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back, press your lower spine firmly into the floor, and lift shoulder blades slightly.
Extend arms overhead by your ears and raise straight legs just above the ground.
Hold a shallow banana curve with continuous abdominal tension.
Bend one or both knees slightly if your lower back starts to lift.
exercises.tips: Your lower back staying anchored to the floor is the non-negotiable standard.
exercises.commonMistakes: Holding your breath or letting the lumbar spine gap off the mat.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang steadily from a pull-up bar with straight arms and legs together.
Curl your pelvis slightly upward as you raise both knees toward your chest.
Pause for a beat at the top without swinging backward.
Lower your legs slowly to a still hang before the next rep.
exercises.tips: Focus on rolling your tailbone up rather than merely lifting thighs with hip flexors.
exercises.commonMistakes: Swinging your whole body like a pendulum.

exercises.name: Hanging Straight-Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms and legs pressed gently together.
Brace your abs and lift straight legs smoothly upward to hip height or higher.
Curl the pelvis gently at the top to fully engage the abdominals.
Lower slowly with zero momentum.
exercises.tips: Keep legs smoothly controlled on the way down to stop any sway.
exercises.commonMistakes: Kicking legs up using a body swing.

exercises.name: Kneeling Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel in front of a high pulley holding a rope tucked beside your temples.
Keep your hips fixed upright over your knees throughout every rep.
Round your upper spine smoothly downward, drawing ribs toward your pelvis.
Pause briefly in full flexion, then uncurl back with control.
exercises.tips: Think about folding your ribcage down rather than sitting your hips back toward your heels.
exercises.commonMistakes: Pulling the rope down with your arms or hinging at the hips.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
instructions: Stand sideways to a chest-height cable or band holding the handle close to your sternum.
Set feet shoulder-width apart with soft knees and square shoulders.
Press your hands straight out in front of your chest, resisting any twist toward the anchor.
Hold two seconds at full extension, return smoothly, and work both sides equally.
exercises.tips: Move slowly and keep your sternum pointing straight ahead the whole time.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting the cable pull your hands off center.

exercises.name: Diagonal Cable Woodchop
instructions: Set a pulley high and stand sideways holding one handle with both hands.
Start with arms extended diagonally up toward the anchor.
Rotate smoothly through your torso and hips to chop the handle across to your opposite hip.
Control the return back up slowly and repeat evenly on both sides.
exercises.tips: Pivot your back foot gently so your hips move cleanly with your ribcage.
exercises.commonMistakes: Bending your arms and yanking the handle without torso rotation.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel on a mat holding an ab wheel directly beneath your shoulders with abs tucked tight.
Roll smoothly forward by opening both your hips and shoulders together.
Extend only as far as you can keep your lower back flat and glutes engaged.
Pull yourself back cleanly by driving arms downward and contracting your abs.
exercises.tips: Maintain a slight hollow pelvic tuck before you even begin rolling.
exercises.commonMistakes: Leaving hips behind or letting your lower back collapse toward the floor.

exercises.name: Controlled Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with fingertips lightly behind your ears and legs raised in tabletop.
Lift shoulder blades off the mat and rotate one shoulder smoothly toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Pause for a half-second in rotation before switching cleanly to the other side.
Move at a calm, deliberate tempo.
exercises.tips: Bring your armpit toward the opposite knee rather than pulling your elbow across your neck.
exercises.commonMistakes: Yanking on the back of your head or pedaling rapidly.

exercises.name: Seated Russian Twist
instructions: Sit tall with knees bent, lean back slightly with a straight spine, and keep heels lightly on the floor or hovered.
Hold a weight or clasp hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your entire ribcage smoothly from one side to the other.
Keep your lower back long and steady throughout.
exercises.tips: Follow the weight with your eyes and shoulders so your torso truly rotates.
exercises.commonMistakes: Rounding the spine and only swinging arms side to side.

exercises.name: Floor Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with arms flat at your sides and knees bent ninety degrees.
Exhale and curl your tailbone and lower back gently off the mat, bringing knees toward your chest.
Hold briefly at the top without kicking your feet.
Lower your pelvis slowly vertebra by vertebra.
exercises.tips: Focus on small, strict spinal curling rather than swinging your legs.
exercises.commonMistakes: Using leg momentum to throw your hips upward.

exercises.name: Slow-Tempo Mountain Climber
instructions: Set up in a solid high plank with wrists stacked straight beneath shoulders.
Drive one knee smoothly forward toward your chest without bouncing your hips.
Return the foot cleanly and bring the opposite knee forward.
Maintain steady breathing and a quiet, flat back.
exercises.tips: Slower controlled reps build stronger core stability than frantic sprinting.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting your hips bounce high into the air.

exercises.name: Two-Hand Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand a foot behind the kettlebell, hinge hips back, and hike the bell high between your thighs.
Snap your hips forward powerfully to project the bell up to chest height with relaxed arms.
Wait until your forearms reconnect with your inner thighs before hinging again.
Park the bell softly back on the floor ahead of you on the last rep.
exercises.tips: The kettlebell swing is a crisp hip hinge, not a squat or front shoulder raise.
exercises.commonMistakes: Hinging too early while the bell is still high, which loads the lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell or Kettlebell Thruster
instructions: Hold dumbbells or a kettlebell at shoulder rack height with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop cleanly into a full squat while keeping your torso upright.
Drive forcefully out of the squat and use your leg momentum to press weights smoothly overhead.
Lower weights back to your shoulders and flow straight into the next squat.
exercises.tips: Keep elbows elevated during the squat so the weights stay balanced over mid-foot.
exercises.commonMistakes: Pressing before your hips finish extending.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Burpee
instructions: Stand tall, then crouch down and plant both hands solidly on the floor.
Step or jump your feet back into a firm high plank with core braced.
Optionally perform a push-up, then bring feet smoothly back outside your hands.
Stand tall or add a light vertical hop overhead.
exercises.tips: Stepping back and forward smoothly keeps form crisp for beginners or longer intervals.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting your hips crash toward the floor during the plank transition.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Clean and Press
instructions: Hinge slightly with dumbbells beside your legs and a flat back.
Extend hips briskly to pull the dumbbells up smoothly onto your shoulders.
Brace your midsection and press both weights straight overhead.
Lower back to shoulders, then hinge cleanly back to the start.
exercises.tips: Keep dumbbells traveling close to your torso during the clean.
exercises.commonMistakes: Swinging the weights out in a wide arc away from your body.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Half Get-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with one arm pressing a light weight straight toward the ceiling and the same-side knee bent.
Roll cleanly onto your opposite elbow, then press up onto your open palm while keeping eyes on the bell.
Drive through your planted foot to lift hips into a crisp bridge.
Reverse each step smoothly back down to the floor before switching sides.
exercises.tips: Keep your stacked arm vertical like a pillar throughout every phase.
exercises.commonMistakes: Shrugging the supporting shoulder or rushing through transitions.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Stand upright with feet together and arms resting at your sides.
Hop feet smoothly out wider than shoulder width while sweeping arms overhead.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with unlocked knees.
Hop cleanly back to center in a steady rhythm.
exercises.tips: Step one foot out at a time for a quiet, low-impact conditioning option.
exercises.commonMistakes: Landing heavily on stiff, locked-out knees.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat Jump
instructions: Stand shoulder-width apart and drop smoothly into a controlled quarter-to-half squat.
Swing arms lightly back, then drive upward explosively into a vertical jump.
Land softly toe-to-heel, absorbing force smoothly back into the next squat.
Reset briefly between reps to preserve jump quality.
exercises.tips: Aim for whisper-quiet landings to protect your knees and ankles.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting knees buckle inward on landing.

exercises.name: Controlled Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on hands and toes with knees hovering just two inches above the floor.
Keep your back flat and hips level as if balancing a cup of water.
Step opposite hand and foot forward smoothly in small, controlled steps.
Reverse backward smoothly if space is limited.
exercises.tips: Take compact steps so your knees never drift far behind your hips.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting your hips sway side to side or rise high.

exercises.name: Barbell Push Press
instructions: Hold a barbell in front-rack position across your shoulders with elbows slightly forward.
Dip straight down three to four inches by bending knees while keeping torso completely upright.
Drive explosively upward through your legs to launch the bar overhead and finish locking out with arms.
Lower under control back to your shoulders and reset your brace.
exercises.tips: Keep the dip vertical and crisp — avoid leaning forward onto your toes.
exercises.commonMistakes: Dipping too deep like a full squat or rebending knees excessively under the bar.

exercises.name: High-Knees Conditioning Run
instructions: Stand tall with elbows bent at ninety degrees and core engaged.
Drive alternating knees briskly up toward hip height while pumping arms in rhythm.
Stay light on the balls of your feet with quick ground contacts.
Keep your chest upright and gaze forward.
exercises.tips: Slow down to a brisk high-knee march for a joint-friendly alternative.
exercises.commonMistakes: Leaning backward to lift knees higher.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Suitcase Carry
instructions: Hold one challenging weight in a single hand at your side as if carrying a heavy suitcase.
Stand completely tall with shoulders level and ribs stacked over your pelvis.
Walk forward steadily without leaning toward or away from the loaded side.
Set the weight down cleanly and match the exact duration on the opposite hand.
exercises.tips: Your goal is to look completely symmetrical as if carrying equal weight in both hands.
exercises.commonMistakes: Tilting your torso sideways away from the weight.

exercises.name: Lunge with Thoracic Twist
instructions: Step one foot forward into a deep runner's lunge and place the opposite palm flat on the floor.
Drop your inside elbow gently toward your front ankle for a hip stretch.
Rotate your chest open toward your front knee and reach that arm tall to the ceiling.
Return the hand down, briefly straighten your front leg for a hamstring stretch, then switch sides.
exercises.tips: Exhale deeply as you twist open toward the sky to unlock extra thoracic range.
exercises.commonMistakes: Rushing through the positions without pausing to breathe.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Spinal Mobility
instructions: Begin on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees beneath hips.
Inhale as you gently drop your belly, lift your chest, and gaze slightly forward.
Exhale smoothly to round your entire back toward the ceiling while tucking tailbone and chin.
Move slowly in sync with relaxed breaths.
exercises.tips: Move segment by segment through your mid-back rather than hinging only in the lower spine.
exercises.commonMistakes: Forcing neck extension aggressively when looking up.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Rotations
instructions: Sit on the floor with your front knee bent ninety degrees in front and back knee bent ninety degrees out to the side.
Sit tall with chest lifted — support lightly behind you with hands if needed.
Lift both knees smoothly to windshield-wiper your legs across to the opposite 90/90 position.
Alternate gently side to side under full control.
exercises.tips: Keep your heels anchored in place as your knees pivot across.
exercises.commonMistakes: Slumping your chest forward to force the switch.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel on one padded knee with the front foot planted ahead at ninety degrees.
Tuck your tailbone gently underneath you by squeezing the glute on your kneeling side.
Shift forward just an inch or two until you feel a clean stretch along the front of your hip.
Hold calmly with slow breaths before switching sides.
exercises.tips: The posterior pelvic tuck creates the stretch — you rarely need to lunge deeply forward.
exercises.commonMistakes: Overarching the lower back while lunging far forward.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Open Book
instructions: Lie on one side with knees bent up to hip height and stacked comfortably together.
Extend both arms straight out in front of your chest with palms touching.
Sweep your top arm in a wide arc across your body toward the floor behind you, following with your eyes.
Exhale into the open stretch, then return smoothly and repeat on the other side.
exercises.tips: Keep your top knee pressed down (or resting on a foam roller) so motion comes from the upper back.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting the top knee lift far off the floor to fake extra twist.

exercises.name: Elevated or Floor Pigeon Stretch
instructions: Place one shin angled across in front of you on the floor or atop a padded bench.
Extend your trailing leg straight behind you with hips square toward the front.
Hinge forward slightly from the hips until you feel a comfortable outer-glute stretch.
Hold calmly while breathing deeply, then repeat on the other side.
exercises.tips: Using an elevated bench or figure-four on your back makes this effortless on sensitive knees.
exercises.commonMistakes: Forcing your knee into torque or collapsing completely onto one hip.

exercises.name: Wall Calf & Ankle Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall with hands pressed at chest height and step one leg straight back.
Press the back heel firmly into the floor with toes pointed straight ahead.
Lean gently forward until you feel a smooth calf stretch, then bend the back knee slightly to target the deeper soleus.
Hold steadily and switch legs.
exercises.tips: Keep the back foot aligned straight ahead rather than turning the toes outward.
exercises.commonMistakes: Bouncing into the stretch or lifting the back heel.

exercises.name: Band Shoulder Pass-Through
instructions: Hold a light resistance band with a very wide grip in front of your thighs.
Keep elbows straight and ribs down as you lift the band smoothly overhead.
Continue arcing the band gently behind your back only as far as your shoulders move comfortably.
Return smoothly to the front.
exercises.tips: Widen your hands anytime you feel pinching or tightness — comfort comes first.
exercises.commonMistakes: Bending elbows or flaring ribs upward to force the band behind you.

exercises.name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Dorsiflexion
instructions: Kneel in half-kneeling position facing a wall with your front toes a few inches away.
Keep your entire front heel glued solidly to the floor.
Drive your front knee smoothly forward toward the wall directly over your middle toes.
Pause briefly at end range, rock back, and match reps on both ankles.
exercises.tips: Great pre-run and pre-squat drill to keep stride and squat depth smooth.
exercises.commonMistakes: Letting your front heel peel off the ground.

exercises.name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie comfortably on your back with one leg resting flat on the floor.
Loop a band or towel around your other foot (or clasp behind the thigh) and gently raise the leg.
Keep your tailbone relaxed on the floor and knee softly straight until you feel a mild stretch.
Hold calmly with slow exhales, then switch legs.
exercises.tips: Gently flexing and pointing the ankle adds light calf release.
exercises.commonMistakes: Pulling so aggressively that your lower back curls off the ground.

exercises.name: Child's Pose with Side Lat Reach
instructions: Kneel on a mat with big toes touching and knees comfortably wide.
Sit your hips gently back toward your heels and walk both hands forward along the floor.
Walk both hands slightly to the left to lengthen the right lat, hold calmly, then repeat to the right.
Rest your forehead gently toward the mat and breathe into your back ribs.
exercises.tips: Use slow, deep belly breaths to release tension across your mid-back and hips.
exercises.commonMistakes: Tensing your shoulders up around your neck.
